node.statement: Amplification: matrix multiplication gives Y^dagger dot V = sum_i Y_i^dagger dot V_i. Substituting the coordinate identities gives sum_i <Y_i,V_i>*u_Q, which equals <Y,V>*u_Q by the defined amplified sesquilinear form. This proves the exact amplified column identity without an estimate or dimension-dependent factor.
